dialogue.context: Existing dialogue. After the letter has been delivered, on a later conversation.

lines.speaker: Irena
lines.text: She says there is a room. With a window that opens.

lines.speaker: Irena
lines.text: I have started deciding what I can carry. That is different from deciding to go.

description: Irena stands by the lamp north-west of the museum. After thirty years of making rope, her hands still twist her bedsheet in her sleep. Her daughter writes from inland. Reading the delivered letter gives her a specific possibility: a newly painted room with a window that opens. She begins deciding what she could carry, while carefully distinguishing that from deciding to leave. The errand changes what she can consider; it does not move her away or settle her future.
name: Irena
